title: Kula Ag Park expansion and new farm reservoir
summary: A contract for a new reservoir and 12-inch water line at Kula Ag Park was recently awarded, and the agriculture director says they will be built before a second park phase of about 24 lots. The reservoir will serve the 31 lots now leased and use almost all the money received, so the second phase will need more funding. In September 2025, the full project was estimated at about $44.3 million, with $20 million still needed.

timeline.text: Bill 23 adds $10 million for the State Department of Agriculture to use on Upcountry Maui agricultural park work.
A council member asked staff to follow up on the Kula Ag Park funding distribution.
